"""design_4BE0 모델링 준비: TP 단위 데이터셋 구성 (학습/성능계산 없음)."""
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
D = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data"; O = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
H = pd.Timedelta(hours=1)
p = pd.read_csv(D/"patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D/"admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time","discharge_time"])
l = pd.read_csv(D/"labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time","report_time"])
l = l.merge(a[["admission_id","admit_time"]], on="admission_id")

def kdigo(times, vals):
    """시간순 크레아티닌 열에서 KDIGO(48h +0.3 / 7일 최솟값 1.5배) 충족 여부 (각 측정 시점 기준)."""
    out = np.zeros(len(vals), bool)
    for i in range(len(vals)):
        prev48 = vals[(times >= times[i]-48*H) & (times < times[i])]
        prev7d = vals[(times >= times[i]-168*H) & (times < times[i])]
        out[i] = (len(prev48) and vals[i]-prev48.min() >= 0.3) or (len(prev7d) and vals[i] >= 1.5*prev7d.min())
    return out

tps = a.merge(p, on="patient_id").loc[lambda d: d.age >= 18]
tps = tps.loc[tps.index.repeat(7)].copy()
tps["offset_h"] = np.tile([24,48,72,96,120,144,168], len(tps)//7)
tps["tp"] = tps.admit_time + tps.offset_h*H
tps["in_hospital_at_tp"] = tps.tp < tps.discharge_time
tps["fully_observed_48h"] = tps.discharge_time >= tps.tp + 48*H

cr = l[l.test=="creatinine"].sort_values("collect_time")
labs_by = {k: g for k, g in l.groupby("admission_id")}
cr_by = {k: g for k, g in cr.groupby("admission_id")}
rows = []
for r in tps.itertuples():
    L = labs_by.get(r.admission_id, l.iloc[:0]); C = cr_by.get(r.admission_id, cr.iloc[:0])
    known = L[(L.report_time >= r.admit_time) & (L.report_time < r.tp)]   # 특성: report_time 기준
    kc = known[known.test=="creatinine"].sort_values("report_time")
    def last(t): s = known[known.test==t].sort_values("report_time").value; return s.iloc[-1] if len(s) else np.nan
    # 제외: tp까지 보고된 크레아티닌으로 AKI 이미 확인
    aki_known = bool(kdigo(kc.collect_time.values, kc.value.values).any()) if len(kc) else False
    # 결과: tp~tp+48h 채취분, 기준값은 tp-168h부터(index admission 내)
    Cw = C[(C.collect_time >= r.tp-168*H) & (C.collect_time < r.tp+48*H)]
    flags = kdigo(Cw.collect_time.values, Cw.value.values) if len(Cw) else np.array([], bool)
    inwin = (Cw.collect_time >= r.tp).values
    rows.append(dict(
        aki_known_by_tp=aki_known,
        aki_48h=bool((flags & inwin).any()), n_cr_outcome_window=int(inwin.sum()),
        cr_min_adm=kc.value.min(), cr_last=kc.value.iloc[-1] if len(kc) else np.nan,
        cr_max_48h=kc[kc.report_time >= r.tp-48*H].value.max(), n_cr=len(kc),
        bun_last=last("bun"), k_last=last("potassium"),
        hgb_min=known[known.test=="hemoglobin"].value.min()))
tps = pd.concat([tps.reset_index(drop=True), pd.DataFrame(rows)], axis=1)
# 분할 키: family_id 결측(80%) → 임시로 patient_id 대체 (확인 필요)
tps["split_group"] = tps.family_id.fillna(tps.patient_id)
g = tps.split_group.drop_duplicates().sample(frac=1, random_state=20261002)
test_g = set(g.iloc[:int(round(0.3*len(g)))])
tps["split"] = np.where(tps.split_group.isin(test_g), "test", "train")
tps.to_csv(O/"tp_dataset_all.csv.gz", index=False)
print(len(tps))
EOF
cd /srv/leakruns/eac822ae25fc-t1/ws && time python3 prep/prepare.py
